name: Human
description: Humans are known for their ingenuity, determination, and adaptability. They excel in diplomacy and exploration.

name: Vulcan
description: Vulcans value logic and reason above all. They are master scientists and negotiators.

name: Klingon
description: Klingons are a warrior culture that values honor, courage, and strength in battle.

name: Romulan
description: Romulans are cunning strategists who value secrecy and deception. Masters of stealth technology.

name: Ferengi
description: Ferengi are driven by profit and commerce. They are the greatest traders in the galaxy.

name: Borg
description: The Borg are a cybernetic collective that assimilates other species. They represent an existential threat.

name: Cardassian
description: Cardassians are militaristic and expansionist, valuing order and discipline above all.

name: Andorian
description: Andorians are fierce warriors from a cold world, known for their military prowess and honor.

name: Betazoid
description: Betazoids are telepathic beings who excel in diplomacy and interspecies communication.

name: Denobulan
description: Denobulans are the greatest healers in the galaxy, with advanced medical knowledge.
